name: mixshift-ai
description: MixShift AI skills for Amazon advertising and retail operations. The MixShift warehouse is a MySQL database (legacy schema: dashamazon) covering Sponsored Ads (SP/SB/SD), DSP, Seller Central + Vendor Central ops revenue, orders, inventory, and dimensional catalog. This plugin ships: data-explore (ad-hoc querying + CSV export), PPC optimization skills (daily health checks, bid management, search term negation, harvest, monthly reporting), and onboarding commands (welcome, brand discover/add). Warehouse access is read-only via the bundled harness; credentials read from ~/.mixshift/auth/credentials.json.
